title: Rules Module
description: Rule-index module for O(1) event lookup. Exports getRulesForEvent(eventName) via bus handle 'rules:get'.

get.description: Get all enabled rules for a specific hook event, sorted by priority.

reload.description: Rebuild the rule index from disk, re-reading rules files.

Rule.description: Single rule definition. Matches events and executes actions with optional conditional logic.

priority.description: Execution order within event. Lower = earlier.

enabled.description: If false, rule is skipped at load time.

action.description: Action to take when rule matches.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the rule (audit trail).

feature.description: Feature flag or tag for grouping related rules.

tool.description: Optional tool name/pattern this rule applies to.

cwd.description: Optional working directory context for this rule.

transform.description: Optional transformation logic applied when rule matches.

RuleIndex.description: Compiled rule index state. Map<eventName, rule[]> built at boot and rebuild on reload.

map.description: Internal: Map serialized as object for reference. Not part of config.

loadedAt.description: Timestamp when rules were last loaded.

title: Rules Module Setup Contract
description: setup(bus, config) → teardown. Loads rules from config.rulesDir, builds Map<eventName, rule[]> for O(1) lookup.

setup.description: Module entry point. Returns teardown function.

rules:get.description: Get rules for event. Input: {eventName}. Output: {rules: Rule[]}.

rules.description: Enabled rules for event, sorted by priority (lower = first).

rules:reload.description: Rebuild rule index from disk. Input: {}. Output: {reloaded: true}.

rulesDir.description: Directory containing rule JSON files. Relative to projectRoot or absolute.
